Case ID: 1153
Case Type: Chargeback Claim
Date: 2025-04-03
Handled By: Claims - Brooke Salazar
Customer or Requestor: Tyler Ames
Title: Friendly fraud dispute on repeat high-risk account

Issue Description
A cardholder disputed a valid order as unauthorized even though the account had multiple previous successful deliveries to the same address and device.

Steps Taken
- Reviewed order risk signals including device fingerprint, IP consistency, and account history.
- Confirmed prior deliveries and customer service interactions tied to the same email, address, and payment method.
- Collected checkout logs, shipment proof, and prior login records for representment.
- Consulted Risk Operations because the account showed a pattern of post-delivery disputes.

Resolution
Submitted a robust representment package and restricted the account from future manual concessions pending the dispute outcome.

Follow-Up
Risk Operations considered placing the account on enhanced review for future purchases.

Reference Documents
- Internal Wiki - Refund Questions
- Refund Playbook v2
